## Error handler
Both lead workflows name this one as their error workflow. Every outbound node retries three times with a five-second wait first; only then does this run. The incident goes to the engine (so `leadintake report` counts it) and to the owner on Telegram with the node, the error and the lead id when it can be recovered. The Google Sheet node is off by default.
